description: For every fixed bounded formula \(D(\vec x)\), PA proves that its specified primitive-recursive truth test has value \(1\) exactly when \(D(\vec x)\) holds.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticProofPredicates.bounded_truth_internal_full {r : ℕ}
  (D : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin r))
  (hD : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.BoundedArithmetic D) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.close
      ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticProofPredicates.testAt
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticProofPredicates.boundedTruth D hD) FirstOrder.Language.var).iff
        D))
